name: Cameroon

fees.name: Short-stay e-visa (standard processing)
fees.applies: all (all visas processed via evisacam.cm since 2023; tourist, business and transit fall under short-stay)
fees.notes: Official ministry fee schedule: 100,000 XAF standard short-stay. Embassies bill local-currency equivalents (e.g. EUR 153 at High Commission London, USD 93 at Embassy Washington). Fees non-refundable even if refused.

fees.name: Short-stay e-visa (express processing)
fees.notes: Express (approx. 24-72h) processing; EUR 229 equivalent published by High Commission London.

fees.name: Tourist/short-stay visa via embassy (Washington DC published fee)
fees.notes: Embassy of Cameroon in Washington DC consular fee schedule; application itself is submitted through the evisacam.cm portal. Long-stay (up to 6 months) USD 184.

fees.name: Transit visa (4-30 days)
fees.applies: all (fee as published by High Commission London; same tariff as standard short-stay)
fees.notes: Transit not required if continuing on same/next connecting flight with valid passport and onward ticket. XAF equivalent 100,000.

fees.name: Business (short-stay) visa
fees.notes: Business travel uses the short-stay visa category; same tariff as tourist short-stay (100,000 XAF standard / 150,000 XAF express).

fees.name: Visa on arrival
fees.notes: No general visa-on-arrival regime since the 2023 e-visa rollout; pre-approval via evisacam.cm is required, with the visa sticker issued on arrival at Douala/Yaounde for approved e-visa holders. No separate on-arrival fee verified.

free_visa_notes: Nationals of CEMAC member states (Chad, CAR, Congo, Gabon, Equatorial Guinea) and Nigeria enter visa-free. No reciprocity-based fee schedule published for other nationalities; the flat XAF tariff applies to all, converted to local currency at each mission. High Commission London notes fee waivers exist for certain applicant categories.
